meta.source: Screenshots of the TASK Super Admin dashboard (9 captures, Sept 2026), pixel-sampled.
meta.target: Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui + lucide

color.note: Light values are sampled from the screenshots. Dark values are derived on the slate family the hero banner already uses, and each text/ground pair is checked in both themes.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind every page. Light is a faintly blue-tinted white, not pure gray.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text: page titles, table row names, form labels, values. 19.0:1 on background (light), 14.0:1 on card (dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Every panel: filter bar, table shell, form card, plan card, modal, dropdown, sidebar.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, select lists, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: segmented-control track, code chip, skeletons, disabled control ground.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: page subtitle, card subtitle, table header labels, placeholders. 4.7:1 on card (light), 5.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: muted-foreground-alt
tokens.usage: The second gray the source uses for sidebar section headers and Created At dates. 4.8:1 on card (light), 5.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover ground for table rows, menu items, ghost buttons and the active item in the Profile side nav.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button and neutral chip ground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary; also plan prices and 'WHAT'S INCLUDED' headings.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, table row separators, input borders, dividers. 1px.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of text inputs, selects, date fields and textareas at rest. 1.3:1 on card — the source's hairline, kept exact; a build that must clear the 3:1 non-text floor swaps in #8f8f8f (3.2:1) and keeps everything else.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a 3px 25%-alpha halo outside a 1px solid border of this color. One step darker than primary so the ring itself clears 3:1 on card (3.2:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: table-header
tokens.usage: Fill of the sticky table header row. Header labels sit on it in muted-foreground at 4.2:1 — the source's own pairing; the sorted column may use foreground instead.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, measured off the Add New Company dialog.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars, progress rings and the off state of a switch.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand emerald. Solid buttons, switch and radio on-state, active sidebar ink, active pagination and view-toggle, progress fill, logo T. White on it is 2.6:1 — the source's own pairing, kept exact; use primary-strong for green text.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill. See the contrast note on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons. Derived (primary darkened 8%) — the screenshots show no hover state.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for primary buttons. Derived.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Primary at 10% over white: Top Plans rank circles, soft emerald chips, selected rows.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Green TEXT and links that must stay legible: 5.4:1 on card (light), 9.6:1 (dark). Use instead of primary wherever green type sits on a light ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Active / Paid / Approved text and icons. 4.7:1 on success-soft (light), 8.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Active, Paid and Approved badges.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: The one solid green chip in the product: the 'Save 20%' pill on the Plans toggle. White text on it is 2.2:1 — source value, kept exact.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Completed / Signed / Sent, plan-name badges and trial pills. 6.3:1 on info-soft (light), 5.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of plan-name badges, trial pills and Completed badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / Partial text, and the orange warning line under Default Plan. 4.8:1 on warning-soft (light), 9.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Pending and Partial badges and the 'Action needed' chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected / Cancelled / Urgent / Overdue text and the delete icon on hover. 5.9:1 on danger-soft (light), 5.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Rejected, Cancelled, Urgent and Overdue badges.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Draft / Inactive text. No screenshot shows this badge, so the value is chosen rather than sampled: 7.1:1 on neutral-soft (light), 7.0:1 (dark).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Draft and Inactive badges.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Required-field asterisks and destructive icon buttons. 3.8:1 on card — enough for a mark, not for small text, and the label always carries the meaning too. Reserve solid fills for confirm-delete actions.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a destructive fill.

tokens.usage: Rounded icon square inside the emerald stat card.

tokens.name: stat-emerald-icon

tokens.name: stat-emerald-label
tokens.usage: Small label above the value in the emerald stat card.

tokens.name: stat-emerald-value
tokens.usage: The big number in the emerald stat card.

tokens.name: stat-blue-label
tokens.usage: Small label above the value in the blue stat card.

tokens.name: stat-blue-value
tokens.usage: The big number in the blue stat card.

tokens.name: stat-violet
tokens.usage: Ground of the violet stat card (Active Plans).

tokens.name: stat-violet-icon-bg

tokens.name: stat-violet-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icon inside the violet stat card's icon square. 5.0:1 on its square.

tokens.name: stat-violet-label
tokens.usage: Small label above the value in the violet stat card.

tokens.name: stat-violet-value
tokens.usage: The big number in the violet stat card.

tokens.name: stat-indigo
tokens.usage: Ground of the indigo stat card (Monthly Growth).

tokens.name: stat-indigo-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Rounded icon square inside the indigo stat card.

tokens.name: stat-indigo-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icon inside the indigo stat card's icon square. 5.3:1 on its square (3.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: stat-indigo-label
tokens.usage: Small label above the value in the indigo stat card.

tokens.name: stat-indigo-value
tokens.usage: The big number in the indigo stat card.

tokens.name: stat-amber
tokens.usage: Ground of the amber stat card (Pending Requests).

tokens.name: stat-amber-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Rounded icon square inside the amber stat card.

tokens.name: stat-amber-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icon inside the amber stat card's icon square. 2.9:1 on its square — the source pairing, kept exact; the label beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: stat-amber-label
tokens.usage: Small label above the value in the amber stat card.

tokens.name: stat-amber-value
tokens.usage: The big number in the amber stat card.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 — the emerald used for the New Companies bars (painted at 70% opacity, #57cca5) and the Monthly Revenue line.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2 — blue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3 — violet.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4 — indigo.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 — amber.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Dashed horizontal gridlines and axis lines.

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: The gray band behind the hovered bar.

tokens.name: chart-area-from
tokens.usage: Top stop of the area fill under the revenue line.

tokens.name: chart-area-to
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the area fill; matches its card.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel, 280px wide, full height.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Idle nav item label and icon.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active nav item: label, icon and the 2px indicator bar beside a sub-item. 2.6:1 on sidebar — pair it with the 500 weight the source uses, or switch to primary-strong where legibility matters more than the exact hue.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a filled sidebar element.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover ground of a nav item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Right edge of the sidebar and the rule under the logo.

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Section headers: Overview, Management, System Control. 4.8:1 on sidebar (light), 5.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Base of the dashboard greeting banner.

tokens.name: hero-foreground
tokens.usage: Greeting name and chip figures. 14.6:1 on hero.

tokens.name: hero-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting line and chip captions on the hero. 8.0:1 on hero.

tokens.name: hero-accent
tokens.usage: The '7 registered companies' line and the drifting dots on the hero. 5.6:1 on hero.

tokens.name: hero-chip
tokens.usage: Glassy stat chip ground on the hero.

tokens.name: hero-chip-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around a hero chip.

tokens.name: hero-glow-teal
tokens.usage: Teal glow that warms the bottom edge of the hero.

tokens.name: hero-glow-slate
tokens.usage: Slate glow in the hero's upper right.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Ground of the monospace coupon-code chip.

tokens.name: code-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of a coupon-code chip.

tokens.name: avatar-ring
tokens.usage: Ring drawn around a stacked or overlapping avatar; matches its card.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Plan price on a pricing card.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero greeting name and the centred Subscription Plans heading.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: Page title, top-left of every page.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Modal title and section heading inside a card.

styles.name: title-row
styles.usage: Primary line of a table row or list item.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Manage your companies and their settings.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card subtitle and the secondary line under a row name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field label, in foreground with a destructive asterisk when required.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label at the default 36px height.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Button label at the 32px toolbar height.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat-card label and caption, chip text, helper text under a field.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Every currency figure in a table or detail row, so decimal points line up.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Coupon codes and other machine strings, inside a code chip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Padding inside a segmented-control track; icon-to-label gap in a badge.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons and between icon actions in a table row.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside inputs; gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of the filter bar; gap between form fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space under a page header block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of an empty state.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed sidebar width; the main column starts here.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Breadcrumb bar height, with a 1px bottom border.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, pagination cells, view-toggle buttons, badges' parent row.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default control height: inputs, selects, date fields, primary and outline buttons.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Search fields inside a filter bar and large form controls.

tokens.name: table-header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the table header row.

tokens.name: table-row-height
tokens.usage: Height of a table body row — tall enough for a 36px avatar plus two text lines.

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card; the filter bar uses 16px.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Lucide icon size in buttons, inputs, menu items and table actions.

tokens.name: icon-size-lg
tokens.usage: Lucide icon size in sidebar items and inside a stat tile.

tokens.name: stat-tile-size
tokens.usage: The rounded square holding a stat card's icon.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: The floating help button, bottom right of every page.

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Avatar diameter in table rows and lists.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox tick container and tiny chips. Tailwind's rounded-xs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Progress bars, indicator caps, skeleton blocks. rounded-sm.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges (24px tall) and the coupon-code chip. rounded-md.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, icon buttons, pagination cells, segmented pills. rounded-lg.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Stat-card icon squares (40x40) and the segmented-control track. rounded-tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, the hero banner, stat cards, plan cards. rounded-xl.

tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: shadow-md

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, select lists, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-danger
tokens.usage: Focus halo on a field in error.

tokens.name: shadow-none
